description: Emergency management analysis is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Attorney General. Includes regional and ministry-wide assessments of emergencies at the Ministry of the Attorney General. Emergencies include commercial power failure, severe weather, civil protest and others. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Attorney General. Its tags are Justice and Public Safety, Justice et sécurité publique, Law and safety, Lois et sécurité. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2022-12-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
